think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed range/units from PostgreSQL docs. 2) Check whether any numeric value (commonly 0 or -1) is documented to switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (e.g., disable/auto/special behavior) rather than just “smaller/larger”. 3) If such a mode-switch value exists, classify as a special knob and record the special value(s); otherwise classify as not special.
